risks.title: Tariffs and trade restrictions squeezing costs and margins

quote.risk_heading: Due to the international nature of our business, geopolitical or economic changes or events, uncertainty or other factors could harm our business and financial performance.

risks.title: Long-term decline in the high-margin print and ink supplies business

quote.risk_heading: If we cannot successfully execute our strategy and continue to develop, manufacture and market innovative products, services and solutions, our business and financial performance may suffer.

risks.title: Rising memory and component costs hurting PC gross margins

quote.risk_heading: We are heavily dependent on third-party suppliers and supply chain issues have adversely affected, and could adversely affect in the future, our financial results.

risks.title: Credit rating downgrade raising funding costs and limiting liquidity

quote.risk_heading: Failure to maintain our credit ratings could adversely affect our liquidity, capital position, borrowing costs and access to capital markets, as well as our subscription based and other offerings.

risks.title: Heavy AI investment may not pay off and may cannibalize sales

quote.risk_heading: We expect the proliferation of AI to have a significant impact on our industry and the markets in which we compete, and the development and use of AI presents competitive, reputational, and liability risks.
